```diff
+.StudioPage {
+  display: flex;
+  flex-direction: column;
+  gap: 1.5rem;
+  margin: 0 auto;
+  max-width: 100rem;
+  padding-bottom: 4rem
+}
+
+.StudioPage .StudioPageHeader {
+  align-items: center;
+  display: flex;
+  flex-wrap: wrap;
+  gap: 1rem;
+  justify-content: space-between
+}
+
+.StudioPage .StudioPageHeader .StudioPageTitle {
+  font-size: 2rem;
+  margin: 0
+}
+
+.StudioPage .StudioPageLoader {
+  display: flex;
+  justify-content: center;
+  padding: 4rem 0
+}
+
+.StudioPage .StudioPageMessage {
+  color: #cfcfcf;
+  font-size: 1.2rem;
+  padding: 4rem 0;
+  text-align: center
+}
+
+.StudioGameList .StudioPageHeader .GoldButton .ButtonBody {
+  font-size: 1rem
+}
+
+.StudioGameList .StudioGameListStatusChip {
+  background-color: #394980;
+  color: #cfcfcf;
+  display: inline-block;
+  font-size: .85em;
+  font-weight: 800;
+  padding: .15rem .6rem
+}
+
+.StudioGameList .StudioGameListStatusChip.StudioGameListStatusChipPublished {
+  background-color: rgba(29, 208, 109, .15);
+  color: #1dd06d
+}
+
+.MiddleScreenPopupBackground .MiddleScreenPopup.SchematicPopup {
+  display: flex;
+  gap: .5rem;
+  max-height: 75vh;
+  max-width: 55rem;
+  min-width: 40rem;
+  overflow-y: scroll;
+  text-align: left
+}
+
+.MiddleScreenPopupBackground .MiddleScreenPopup.SchematicPopup .SchematicPopupTitle {
+  font-size: 2.5rem;
+  font-weight: 700;
+  margin: 0
+}
+
+.MiddleScreenPopupBackground .MiddleScreenPopup.SchematicPopup .SchematicPopupSubtitle {
+  color: #cfcfcf;
+  font-size: 1rem;
+  font-weight: 700;
+  margin: 1rem 0 0
+}
+
+.MiddleScreenPopupBackground .MiddleScreenPopup.SchematicPopup .SchematicPopupSubtitle.Hidden {
+  display: none
+}
+
+.MiddleScreenPopupBackground .MiddleScreenPopup.SchematicPopup .SchematicPopupSchematicListContainer {
+  border: 2px solid #303a59;
+  border-radius: 0;
+  box-sizing: border-box;
+  overflow-y: auto;
+  padding: .5rem;
+  width: 100%
+}
+
+.SchematicImageContainer {
+  align-items: center;
+  display: flex;
+  font-size: 2rem;
+  height: 100%;
+  justify-content: center;
+  left: 0;
+  top: 0;
+  width: 100%;
+  z-index: 1
+}
+
+.SchematicImageContainer .LogoLoaderOuter {
+  border-color: #a4a4a4 #f2f2f2 #f2f2f2
+}
+
+.SchematicImageContainer .SchematicImage {
+  background-position: 50%;
+  background-repeat: no-repeat;
+  background-size: cover;
+  height: 100%;
+  left: 0;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: 0;
+  width: 100%
+}
+
+.SchematicImageContainer .SchematicImage.SchematicImageFadeIn {
+  animation-duration: .3s;
+  animation-fill-mode: backwards;
+  animation-iteration-count: 1;
+  animation-name: fadeIn;
+  isolation: isolate
+}
+
+.SchematicImageContainer .SchematicImageError {
+  color: #cfcfcf;
+  opacity: .4
+}
+
+.Table {
+  border-collapse: collapse;
+  width: 100%
+}
+
+@keyframes rainbowShimmer {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: translateX(88.88889%)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes rainbowShimmerPosition {
+  to {
+    background-position: -200% 0
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUp {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.6)
+  }
+
+  50% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1.1)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUpNoOversize {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.8)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes shake {
+  0% {
+    rotate: 3deg
+  }
+
+  5% {
+    rotate: -2deg
+  }
+
+  10% {
+    rotate: 2deg
+  }
+
+  15% {
+    rotate: -3deg
+  }
+
+  20% {
+    rotate: 0deg
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes loadingShimmer {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateX(-66.6666666667%)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: none
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes topRightStackIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateX(1.5rem)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+}
+
+.StudioTable {
+  background-color: #3c4b68;
+  border: 1px solid #0f0f0f;
+  border-radius: 0;
+  box-sizing: border-box;
+  text-align: left
+}
+
+.StudioTable thead {
+  background-color: #394980
+}
+
+.StudioTable thead th {
+  color: #a4a4a4;
+  font-size: .85em;
+  font-weight: 800;
+  padding: .75rem 1rem;
+  text-transform: uppercase
+}
+
+.StudioTable tbody tr {
+  border-top: 1px solid hsla(0, 0%, 95%, .1);
+  cursor: pointer
+}
+
+@media(hover:hover) {
+  .StudioTable tbody tr:hover {
+    background-color: #394980
+  }
+}
+
+.StudioTable tbody tr.pad-focused {
+  background-color: #394980
+}
+
+@media(hover:none) {
+  .StudioTable tbody tr:active {
+    background-color: #394980
+  }
+}
+
+.StudioTable tbody tr td {
+  padding: .6rem 1rem
+}
+
+.StudioTable .StudioTableGameCell {
+  align-items: center;
+  display: flex;
+  gap: .75rem
+}
+
+.StudioTable .StudioTableGameCell .StudioTableThumbnail {
+  aspect-ratio: 3/2;
+  border-radius: 0;
+  flex-shrink: 0;
+  height: 3rem;
+  overflow: hidden;
+  position: relative
+}
+
+.StudioTable .StudioTableGameCell .StudioTableThumbnail .StudioTableThumbnailImage {
+  height: 100%;
+  object-fit: cover;
+  width: 100%
+}
+
+.StudioTable .StudioTableGameCell .StudioTableGameName {
+  font-weight: 800
+}
```

```diff
+@keyframes rainbowShimmer {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: translateX(88.88889%)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes rainbowShimmerPosition {
+  to {
+    background-position: -200% 0
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUp {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.6)
+  }
+
+  50% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1.1)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUpNoOversize {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.8)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes shake {
+  0% {
+    rotate: 3deg
+  }
+
+  5% {
+    rotate: -2deg
+  }
+
+  10% {
+    rotate: 2deg
+  }
+
+  15% {
+    rotate: -3deg
+  }
+
+  20% {
+    rotate: 0deg
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes loadingShimmer {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateX(-66.6666666667%)
+  }
+
+  to {

+  }

+
```

```diff
+.SkyblockQuestTracker {
+  border-top: 1px solid #3c4b68;
+  flex-shrink: 0;
+  margin-top: .85rem;
+  padding-top: .85rem;
+  pointer-events: none
+}
+
+.SkyblockQuestTracker .SkyblockQuestTrackerBody {
+  align-items: stretch;
+  box-sizing: border-box;
+  display: flex;
+  flex-direction: column;
+  gap: .2rem;
+  position: relative;
+  text-align: left;
+  white-space: normal;
+  width: 100%
+}
+
+.SkyblockQuestTracker .SkyblockQuestTrackerBody .SkyblockQuestTrackerTitle {
+  align-items: baseline;
+  display: flex;
+  gap: .75rem;
+  justify-content: space-between
+}
+
+.SkyblockQuestTracker .SkyblockQuestTrackerBody .SkyblockQuestTrackerTitle .SkyblockQuestClock {
+  font-feature-settings: "tnum";
+  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums
+}
+
+.SkyblockQuestTracker .SkyblockQuestTrackerBody .SkyblockQuestTrackerPulse {
+  animation: SkyblockQuestTrackerPulse 1.6s ease-out;
+  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #ffb914, 0 0 1.6rem rgba(255, 185, 20, .8);
+  inset: 0;
+  opacity: 0;
+  overflow: hidden;
+  pointer-events: none;
+  position: absolute
+}
+
+.SkyblockQuestTracker .SkyblockQuestTrackerBody .SkyblockQuestTrackerPulse:after {
+  animation: SkyblockQuestTrackerShine .9s ease-out;
+  background: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent, rgba(255, 185, 20, .35), transparent);
+  bottom: 0;
+  content: "";
+  position: absolute;
+  top: 0;
+  transform: translateX(-100%);
+  width: 40%
+}
+
+.SkyblockQuestTracker .SkyblockQuestStep {
+  isolation: isolate;
+  position: relative
+}
+
+.SkyblockQuestTracker .SkyblockQuestStep.JustFinished:before {
+  animation: SkyblockQuestStepFlash var(--quest-step-flash) ease-out;
+  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(29, 208, 109, .5), rgba(29, 208, 109, 0));
+  content: "";
+  inset: -.15rem -.35rem;
+  opacity: 0;
+  pointer-events: none;
+  position: absolute;
+  z-index: -1
+}
+
+.SkyblockQuestTracker .SkyblockQuestStep.JustFinished .SkyblockQuestStepIcon,
+.SkyblockQuestTracker .SkyblockQuestStep.JustFinished .SkyblockQuestStepMark {
+  animation: SkyblockQuestStepPop var(--quest-step-pop) cubic-bezier(.3, 1.6, .5, 1)
+}
+
+.SkyblockQuestTracker .SkyblockQuestStep.ready.JustFinished:before {
+  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 185, 20, .5), rgba(255, 185, 20, 0))
+}
+
+.SkyblockQuestTracker .SkyblockQuestStep.completed.JustFinished,
+.SkyblockQuestTracker .SkyblockQuestStep.skipped.JustFinished {
+  animation: SkyblockQuestStepSettle var(--quest-step-flash) ease-out
+}
+
+.SkyblockQuestTracker .SkyblockQuestStep.JustUnlocked {
+  animation: SkyblockQuestStepUnlock var(--quest-step-unlock) ease-out var(--quest-step-unlock-delay) both
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockQuestTrackerPulse {
+
+  0%,
+  30% {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockQuestTrackerShine {
+  to {
+    transform: translateX(250%)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockQuestStepFlash {
+
+  0%,
+  40% {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockQuestStepPop {
+  0% {
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+
+  40% {
+    transform: scale(1.6) rotate(-8deg)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockQuestStepSettle {
+
+  0%,
+  60% {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: .65
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockQuestStepUnlock {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateX(-.75rem)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: none
+  }

+.SkyblockMoon {

+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogMote {
+  0% {
+    opacity: .08;
+    transform: translateZ(0) scale(.85)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: .3;
+    transform: translate3d(var(--drift-x), var(--drift-y), 0) scale(1.1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogBubbleRise {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateZ(0)
+  }
+
+  10% {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+
+  80% {
+    opacity: .8
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translate3d(0, -100%, 0)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogBubbleSway {
+  0% {
+    translate: calc(var(--sway)*-1) 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    translate: var(--sway) 0
+  }
+}
+

+  .SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogMote,

+@keyframes SkyblockQuestNotificationFade {
+
+  0%,
+  to {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+
+  10%,
+  85% {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockQuestNotificationCelebrate {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateY(.5rem) scale(.94)
+  }
+
+  8% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: translateY(0) scale(1.03)
+  }
+
+  14%,
+  85% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: translateY(0) scale(1)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateY(-.35rem)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockQuestNotificationStepComplete {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.96)
+  }
+
+  12%,
+  80% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateX(-1.5rem)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockQuestNotificationCheck {
+  0% {
+    transform: scale(.4)
+  }
+
+  60% {
+    transform: scale(1.3)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockQuestNotificationNext {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateX(2rem)
+  }
+
+  8%,
+  90% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateY(-.35rem)
+  }
+}

+

+}
```

```diff
+  width: max(1.4rem, 14px)
+}

+.NxLaneNum {
+  overflow: hidden;

+}

+.NxLaneNum {

+  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
+  font-weight: 700
+}

+.NxLanePreview {
+  font-size: .7em;
+  opacity: .7
+}
+
+.NxLaneNote {

+  overflow-wrap: anywhere
+}

+.NxLaneFill {

+  left: 0;
+  position: absolute;
+  transition: width .9s linear
+}
+
+.NxPipe {
+  align-self: center;
+  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, currentColor 0 6px, transparent 6px 10px);
+  background-size: 10px 3px;
+  color: #838383;
+  display: block;
+  height: 3px;
+  margin-right: 5px;
+  position: relative
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Fuel {
+  color: #b6ff3b
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Water {
+  color: #3fd0f0
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Cryo {
+  color: #a8f0ff
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Power {
+  color: #f2c94c
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Waste {
+  color: #d9a73a
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Store {
+  color: #f2c94c
+}
+
+.NxPipe:after {
+  border: 4.5px solid transparent;
+  border-left: 5px solid;
+  border-right: 0;
+  content: "";
+  position: absolute;
+  right: -5px;
+  top: -3px
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Planned,
+.NxPipe.Step0 {
+  color: #838383
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Short {
+  color: #ffb914
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Short:before {
+  color: #fcd373;
+  content: "!";
+  font-size: 10px;
+  font-weight: 700;
+  left: 50%;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: -1.1em;
+  transform: translateX(-50%)
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Step1 {
+  animation: NxPipeFlow 1.6s linear infinite
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Step2 {
+  animation: NxPipeFlow .8s linear infinite
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Step3 {
+  animation: NxPipeFlow .45s linear infinite
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Step4 {
+  animation: NxPipeFlow .25s linear infinite
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Planned {
+  animation: none
+}
+
+@keyframes NxPipeFlow {
+  0% {
+    background-position: 0 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    background-position: 10px 0
+  }
+}
+
+.NxGauge {
+  background: none;
+  border: 0;
+  color: inherit;
+  cursor: pointer;
+  display: flex;
+  font: inherit;
+  gap: 3px;
+  min-height: 0;
+  padding: 0
+}
+
+.NxGauge,
+.NxGaugeTrack {
+  height: 100%;
+  position: relative
+}
+
+.NxGaugeTrack {
+  background: #1a1f2e;
+  overflow: visible;
+  width: max(.9rem, 10px)
+}
+
+.NxGaugeBand {
+  left: 0;
+  opacity: .85;
+  position: absolute;
+  right: 0
+}
+
+.NxGaugeBand.cold {
+  background: #5aa9ff
+}
+
+.NxGaugeBand.warm {
+  background: #ffb020
+}
+
+.NxGaugeBand.hot {
+  background: #ff7a2b
+}
+
+.NxGaugeBand.red {
+  background: #ff3b30
+}
+
+.NxGaugeBand.Store {
+  background: #f2c94c
+}
+
+.NxGaugeBand.Empty {
+  background: #1a1f2e
+}
+
+.NxGaugeNow,
+.NxGaugeSettle {
+  height: 4px;
+  left: -3px;
+  margin-bottom: -2px;
+  position: absolute;
+  right: -3px;
+  transition: bottom .9s linear
+}
+
+.NxGaugeNow {
+  background: #fff;
+  border: 1px solid #000
+}
+
+.NxGaugeSettle {
+  border: 5px solid transparent;
+  border-left: 0;
+  border-right: 7px solid #fff;
+  height: 0;
+  left: auto;
+  margin-bottom: -5px;
+  right: -7px;
+  transition: none;
+  width: 0
+}
+
+.NxGaugeSettle.Bad {
+  border-right-color: #ff3b30
+}
+
+.NxGaugeTicks {
+  height: 100%;
+  position: relative;
+  width: max(1.6rem, 16px)
+}
+
+.NxGaugeTicks small {
+  color: #a4a4a4;
+  font-size: max(.75rem, 9px);
+  left: 6px;
+  line-height: 1;
+  position: absolute;
+  transform: translateY(50%)
+}
+
+.NxStatus {
+  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
+  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
+  color: #f2f2f2;
+  display: -webkit-box;
+  font-size: max(.95rem, 10px);
+  line-height: 1.3;
+  margin: 0;
+  min-height: 2.6em;
+  overflow: hidden
+}
+
+.NxStatus.bad {

+}
+
+.NxStatus.warn {
+  color: #fcd373
+}
+
+.NxStatus.ok {
+  color: #1dd06d
+}
+
+.NxStatus.Explain {
+  color: #85baff
+}
+
+.NxStatusWhy {
+  background: #85baff;
+  border-radius: 50%;
+  color: #22283b;
+  display: inline-block;
+  margin-right: .35em;
+  min-width: 1.2em;
+  text-align: center
+}
+
+@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {
+  .NxPipe {
+    animation: none !important
+  }
+
+  .NxGaugeNow,
+  .NxLaneFill {
+    transition: none
+  }
+}
```

```diff
+@keyframes HelperSlideKeyFrame {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateY(calc(-100% - 30px))
+  }
+
+  33% {
+    transform: translateY(0)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: translateY(0)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes HelperSlideKeyFrameReverse {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateY(0)
+  }
+
+  66% {
+    transform: translateY(0)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: translateY(calc(-100% - 30px))
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes ExpandNotification {
+  0% {
+    transform: scaleX(.05)
+  }
+
+  33% {
+    transform: scaleX(.05)
+  }
+
+  66% {
+    transform: scaleX(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes CloseNotification {
+  0% {
+    transform: scaleX(1)
+  }
+
+  33% {
+    transform: scaleX(1)
+  }
+
+  66% {
+    transform: scaleX(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes textAppear {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+
+  66% {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes textDisappear {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+
+  33% {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+}

+  opacity: .5;

+.JoystickZone .Joystick .JoystickKnob {

+  top: 50%;

+  position: absolute
```

```diff
+@keyframes rainbowShimmer {

+  to {
+    transform: translateX(88.88889%)
+  }

+
+@keyframes rainbowShimmerPosition {

+    background-position: -200% 0
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUp {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.6)
+  }
+
+  50% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1.1)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUpNoOversize {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.8)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
```

```diff
+@keyframes PlotsStepCardIn {

+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateY(.4rem)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes PlotsStepCardCelebrate {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.85)
+  }
+
+  60% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1.06)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@media(max-height:420px), (max-width:650px) {
+  .PlotsStepCard {
+    gap: 6px;
+    padding: 4px 8px
+  }
+
+  .PlotsStepCard .PlotsStepCardIcon {
+    font-size: max(2.2rem, 16px)
+  }
+
+  .PlotsStepCard .PlotsStepCardBody {
+    gap: 2px
+  }
+
+  .PlotsStepCard .PlotsStepCardBody .PlotsStepCardTitle {
+    font-size: max(1.4rem, 12px)
+  }
+
+  .PlotsStepCard .PlotsStepCardBody .PlotsStepCardHint {
+    font-size: max(1.15rem, 11px)
+  }
+}
+
+@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {
+
+  .PlotsStepCard,
+  .PlotsStepCard.Celebrate {
+    animation: none
+  }
+}
```

```diff
+.Store {

+  min-height: 0;
+  overflow-x: hidden;
+  overflow-y: auto;
+  padding: var(--storePad) calc(var(--storePad)*1.5);
+  padding-left: max(var(--storePad)*1.5, var(--notchLeft));
+  padding-right: max(var(--storePad)*1.5, var(--notchRight));
+  position: relative;
+  width: 100%

+@media(hover:hover) {

+.StoreRecipientStrip .StoreRecipientChips {

+  display: flex;
+  flex: 1 1;
+  gap: 0 .6rem;
+  height: calc(100% + var(--scrollbarRoom));
+  margin: calc(var(--headRoom)*-1) 0 calc(var(--scrollbarRoom)*-1);
+  min-width: 0;
+  overflow-x: auto;
```
